title: 15. Unsupervised Clustering: K-Means & DBSCAN
description: Discover natural clusters using K-Means, the Elbow Method, Hierarchical Dendrograms, and DBSCAN.

blocks.content:
### Unsupervised Clustering Algorithms

#### K-Means Clustering & Centroids
K-Means iteratively positions $k$ centroids to minimize within-cluster sum of squares.

![K-Means Cluster Centroids](/images/ml/chart_kmeans_clusters.png)

![Elbow Method Plot](/images/ml/chart_elbow_method.png)

#### Hierarchical & DBSCAN Density Clustering
- **Hierarchical**: Builds nested tree clusters (dendrogram).
- **DBSCAN**: Identifies non-spherical clusters and marks isolated points as noise ($-1$).

![Hierarchical Dendrogram](/images/ml/chart_dendrogram.png)

![DBSCAN Non-Spherical Moons](/images/ml/chart_dbscan_moons.png)

Clustering groups similar items without labels, like sorting a mixed box of buttons by size and color. K-means looks for a chosen number of centres; DBSCAN looks for dense neighborhoods.

Clusters are patterns, not facts stamped on the world. Different settings can create different groupings, so check whether the groups make sense for the real question.

blocks.starterCode:
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
import numpy as np

X = np.array([[1, 2], [1.5, 1.8], [5, 8], [8, 8], [1, 0.6], [9, 11]])
km = KMeans(n_clusters=2, n_init=10, random_state=42)
labels = km.fit_predict(X)
print('Assigned Clusters:', labels)
print('Centroids:\n', km.cluster_centers_)

from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
import numpy as np

X = np.array([[1, 2], [1.5, 1.8], [5, 8], [8, 8], [1, 0.6], [9, 11]])
km = KMeans(n_clusters=2, n_init=10, random_state=42)
labels = km.fit_predict(X)
print('Assigned Clusters:', labels)
print('Centroids:\n', km.cluster_centers_)
